mechanism.claim: Crypto risk transfer has persistent hour-of-week structure. The two strongest positive and two strongest negative six-hour slots learned only from pre-2023 high-volatility observations should retain direction when volatility is elevated.
mechanism.side: frozen sign of the selected pre-2023 hour-of-week mean return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVHOW is a four-slot weekly seasonality model. It uses no event threshold, price-path direction, cross-asset feed, funding settlement, weekend-only rule, or prior candidate control. The slot model is frozen before any 2023H2+ incidence is opened.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: only four of 168 weekly slots are eligible and volatility further thins incidence

training_contract.anchors: each completed xx:55 UTC 5m bar; entry is the next exact hour open
training_contract.label: log(open at entry+72 bars/open at entry), six elapsed hours
training_contract.slot_floor: at least 100 complete high-volatility fit labels per slot
training_contract.slot_score: arithmetic mean of complete fit log-return labels
training_contract.selection: two largest positive means and two smallest negative means; deterministic score then slot-id tie break; failure if either sign has fewer than two eligible slots

oos_clock.decision: each completed xx:55 UTC bar from 2023-07-01 onward
oos_clock.eligibility: entry hour-of-week is one of four frozen slots and range_vol>=frozen q60
oos_clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: freeze preregistration, fit only pre-2023, calibrate source-only 2023H1, freeze model, then open OOS incidence; terminal first failure with no slot, sign, hold, or gate repair
